text:
alex: hey y'all, first day here! SSO login worked but trying to enroll a Windows passkey throws 'platform authenticator not available' in Chrome. also my 1Password invite shows 'link expired' when i try to accept. i need access to eng/onboarding and repo read access. who do i ping? :wave:
it-support: welcome @alex! :tada: tagging @ida (IDP) for the passkey/Okta bit and @kyra for 1Password invites/shipping. quick workarounds: we can add you to a temp new-hires vault, enable Okta Email for MFA, or ship a YubiKey if needed. any preference?

alex: temp vault and Okta Email would be great for now. prefer not to wait on shipping. i'm on Windows 11, Chrome latest, company laptop enrolled via Intune.

ida: hey @alex  that Chrome error usually means Windows WebAuthn is disabled or the browser isn't allowed to use the platform authenticator. two quick checks: 1) go to chrome://flags and ensure "WebAuthn" flags are default/enabled, 2) verify Windows Hello is set up (Settings -> Accounts -> Sign-in options). I'll look at your Okta device policy too.

it-support: sending a temp new-hires vault now with links to eng/onboarding and a repo token (expires 8h). also enabling Okta Email factor for 2 hours so you can finish initial sign-ins. check your email/spam.

okta-bot: Device enrollment note: platform authenticators require device trust and a supported browser. If Windows Hello is not configured, fallback factors (Email/SMS/Authenticator app) may be required. To request hardware key shipping, file IT ticket with address.

alex: got the temp vault, thanks. tried the Windows Hello flow but the "set up" button is greyed out (corporate policy?). Chrome flags look normal.

ida: if Hello is blocked by Intune policy we can still enroll a roaming passkey (FIDO2 security key) or let you use an authenticator app (1Password/TOTP) temporarily. i'll check Intune device config and Okta policy. please confirm your device serial (DM) so i can target the policy exception.

kyra: re 1Password: i see an earlier invite that expired. resend incoming and i'll add a 48h temporary seat to "new-hires-temp" so you can store creds. if you need the seat long-term say so and i'll escalate.

alex: resend worked, i could accept 1Password now. quick question: can i use 1Password TOTP on Windows until Hello/passkey is sorted? i do most dev in Windows terminal.

it-support: yes — two options: 1) use 1Password desktop app + browser extension on Windows to generate TOTPs, or 2) install 1Password CLI if you prefer a terminal workflow. both are fine. instructions in the vault.

ida: update: Intune has a restriction preventing Windows Hello on some build groups. i've opened a device exemption for your laptop (exemption ID: IDP-EX-442). should be applied in ~15 minutes. i'll also relax Okta device enforcement for your user for 12h to avoid lockouts.

alex: thanks — that should do it. one more: how do i request repo read access? the onboarding doc mentions infra/access-requests but not the exact steps.

it-support: open an issue in infra/access-requests with repo list and your company email, or DM @it-support with repo names and i'll add you to the read-only team. If you need immediate access to one repo for setup, list it here and i'll grant it for 4 hours.

alex: could you grant read to repo "eng/example-starter" for now? i'll open the infra ticket too.

it-support: granted read for "eng/example-starter" (4h). let us know if you need longer.

ida: exemption applied; you should be able to enable Windows Hello now. let me know if Chrome still refuses to register a passkey — we can fallback to a YubiKey enrollment or keep 1Password TOTP.

alex: tried Hello after exemption and passkey enrollment succeeded! slack and drive access are working now. huge thanks. any tips to avoid losing access?

kyra: quick tips: enroll a secondary factor (phone or backup passkey or YubiKey), save your 1Password emergency kit, and add a recovery phone to Google. If you want a YubiKey later we can ship one — DM me address.

alex: will do backups. marking this resolved from my side. thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:

ida: leaving the exemption ticket open 24h in case anything else pops up. re-open here if needed. :thumbsup:
